sql.orders:
SELECT IF(nm_id IN UNNEST([252442517, 305101361, 593111986, 567668635]), CAST(nm_id AS STRING), 'OTHER') k, COUNT(*) orders_gross, COUNTIF(is_cancel) cancelled, COUNTIF(NOT is_cancel) orders_net,
     SUM(price_with_disc) seller_price_orders_gross_rub, SUM(IF(NOT is_cancel, price_with_disc, 0)) seller_price_orders_net_rub
   FROM `project-fa311fc0-4d87-4781-986.wb_mart.FACT_ORDERS` WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-09-17' AND order_date IN UNNEST([DATE '2026-09-01', DATE '2026-09-02', DATE '2026-09-03', DATE '2026-09-04', DATE '2026-09-05', DATE '2026-09-06', DATE '2026-09-07', DATE '2026-09-08', DATE '2026-09-09', DATE '2026-09-10', DATE '2026-09-11', DATE '2026-09-12', DATE '2026-09-13', DATE '2026-09-14', DATE '2026-09-15', DATE '2026-09-16', DATE '2026-09-17']) AND nm_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT nm_id FROM `project-fa311fc0-4d87-4781-986.wb_raw.REF_SKU_MASTER` WHERE marketplace='WB' AND active AND nm_id IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY ROLLUP(k)
sql.sales:
SELECT IF(nm_id IN UNNEST([252442517, 305101361, 593111986, 567668635]), CAST(nm_id AS STRING), 'OTHER') k, COUNTIF(NOT is_return) buyouts, COUNTIF(is_return) returns_,
     SUM(IF(NOT is_return, price_with_disc, 0)) seller_price_buyouts_rub, SUM(IF(NOT is_return, finished_price, 0)) buyer_paid_buyouts_rub,
     SUM(IF(NOT is_return, total_price, 0)) list_price_buyouts_rub
   FROM `project-fa311fc0-4d87-4781-986.wb_mart.FACT_SALES` WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-09-17' AND sale_date IN UNNEST([DATE '2026-09-01', DATE '2026-09-02', DATE '2026-09-03', DATE '2026-09-04', DATE '2026-09-05', DATE '2026-09-06', DATE '2026-09-07', DATE '2026-09-08', DATE '2026-09-09', DATE '2026-09-10', DATE '2026-09-11', DATE '2026-09-12', DATE '2026-09-13', DATE '2026-09-14', DATE '2026-09-15', DATE '2026-09-16', DATE '2026-09-17']) AND nm_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT nm_id FROM `project-fa311fc0-4d87-4781-986.wb_raw.REF_SKU_MASTER` WHERE marketplace='WB' AND active AND nm_id IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY ROLLUP(k)
sql.cohort:
WITH s AS (SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(srid),'') srid, COUNTIF(NOT is_return) se FROM `project-fa311fc0-4d87-4781-986.wb_raw.V_WB_SALES_RETURNS` GROUP BY 1),
   o AS (SELECT o.nm_id, CASE WHEN IFNULL(s.se,0) > 0 AND o.is_cancel THEN 'CONFLICT' WHEN IFNULL(s.se,0) > 0 THEN 'BUYOUT'
                              WHEN o.is_cancel THEN 'CANCELLED' ELSE 'UNRESOLVED' END oc
         FROM `project-fa311fc0-4d87-4781-986.wb_mart.FACT_ORDERS` o LEFT JOIN s ON s.srid = o.order_srid WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-09-17' AND o.order_date IN UNNEST([DATE '2026-09-01', DATE '2026-09-02', DATE '2026-09-03', DATE '2026-09-04', DATE '2026-09-05', DATE '2026-09-06', DATE '2026-09-07', DATE '2026-09-08', DATE '2026-09-09', DATE '2026-09-10', DATE '2026-09-11', DATE '2026-09-12', DATE '2026-09-13', DATE '2026-09-14', DATE '2026-09-15', DATE '2026-09-16', DATE '2026-09-17']) AND o.nm_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT nm_id FROM `project-fa311fc0-4d87-4781-986.wb_raw.REF_SKU_MASTER` WHERE marketplace='WB' AND active AND nm_id IS NOT NULL))
   SELECT IF(nm_id IN UNNEST([252442517, 305101361, 593111986, 567668635]), CAST(nm_id AS STRING), 'OTHER') k, COUNT(*) cohort_orders, COUNTIF(oc='BUYOUT') cohort_buyout, COUNTIF(oc='CANCELLED') cohort_cancelled,
     COUNTIF(oc='UNRESOLVED') cohort_unresolved, COUNTIF(oc='CONFLICT') cohort_conflict FROM o GROUP BY ROLLUP(k)
sql.chain:
SELECT IF(nm_id IN UNNEST([252442517, 305101361, 593111986, 567668635]), CAST(nm_id AS STRING), 'OTHER') k, COUNTIF(supplier_oper_name='Продажа') fin_sales, COUNTIF(supplier_oper_name='Возврат') fin_returns,
     COUNTIF(NOT price_chain_available) rows_without_chain,
     SUM(IF(supplier_oper_name='Возврат', -1, 1) * seller_price_rub) fin_seller_price_rub, SUM(IF(supplier_oper_name='Возврат', -1, 1) * buyer_paid_rub) fin_buyer_paid_rub, SUM(IF(supplier_oper_name='Возврат', -1, 1) * spp_rub) spp_rub,
     SUM(IF(supplier_oper_name='Возврат', -1, 1) * wb_remuneration_rub) wb_remuneration_rub, SUM(IF(supplier_oper_name='Возврат', -1, 1) * wb_remuneration_vat_rub) wb_remuneration_vat_rub,
     SUM(IF(supplier_oper_name='Возврат', -1, 1) * acquiring_rub) acquiring_rub, SUM(IF(supplier_oper_name='Возврат', -1, 1) * pvz_reward_rub) pvz_reward_rub, SUM(price_chain_rounding_rub) rounding_rub,
     SUM(marketplace_fee_gap_rub) spread_rub, SUM(IF(supplier_oper_name='Возврат', -1, 1) * for_pay_rub) credited_for_goods_rub
   FROM `project-fa311fc0-4d87-4781-986.wb_mart.V_WB_FINANCE_PRICE_COMPONENTS` WHERE finance_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-09-17' AND finance_date IN UNNEST([DATE '2026-09-01', DATE '2026-09-02', DATE '2026-09-03', DATE '2026-09-04', DATE '2026-09-05', DATE '2026-09-06', DATE '2026-09-07', DATE '2026-09-08', DATE '2026-09-09', DATE '2026-09-10', DATE '2026-09-11', DATE '2026-09-12', DATE '2026-09-13', DATE '2026-09-14', DATE '2026-09-15', DATE '2026-09-16']) AND in_mart_universe GROUP BY ROLLUP(k)
